verdict.rationale: Moss ships keyword search natively: retrieval modes include keyword and a hybrid blend tuned with `alpha`, where 0.0 means pure keyword. The GitHub README confirms built-in 'semantic + Keyword Search', so no separate search engine is needed. missing for 10: documentation of full-text mechanics (ranking such as BM25, tokenization, phrase or boolean queries), independent or hands-on corroboration of keyword result quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run keyword/full-text search over documents inside the database without bolting on a separate search engine

citations.quote: Hybrid - blends both, tuned with `alpha` (1.0 semantic, 0.0 keyword, default 0.8)
Hybrid retrieval (semantic + Keyword Search), built-in embeddings, metadata filtering
